decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation builds directly on the firm's in-house laser know-how and fills out a multi-model line, though its lower website visibility suggests a modest risk of being folded into newer cabins.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core coding business, still has its own page after two years, and draws on knowledge the firm can readily apply and improve.
The piezo inkjet printer extends the firm's established inkjet competence, keeps its own page, and benefits from in-house R&D for further development.
This flagship laser marking line is featured on the home page and anchors the firm's strategic direction, building on deep accumulated laser expertise.
The newly launched compact laser cabin complements the flagship laser line and uses the same knowledge base, so early market learning can be absorbed easily.
The award-winning lubricant printing system transfers the firm's high-resolution inkjet know-how to a niche in sheet metal processing, and the early external validation favours keeping it.
